profile.headline: SAP Solution Architect at L3Harris Technologies
profile.summary:
Senior SAP Software Engineer with 18+ years of experience delivering enterprise-grade solutions across SAP HCM/HR, SAP US Payroll, SuccessFactors EC Payroll, SAP ABAP development, SAP MDM, and SAP S/4HANA. Most recently at Microsoft, I engineered and governed SAP MDM and HR Master Data for the federal S/4 platform, driving consolidation, automation, and high-quality master data across complex, regulated environments.  

I bring deep expertise in Material Master & HR Master Data architecture and configuration, Payroll schemas/rules, cross-system integrations, data modeling, and end-to-end data migration using LSMW, MDG Consolidation, LTMC, custom ABAP ETL frameworks, and Azure-connected OData services. My technical breadth spans ABAP Objects, BADIs, Enhancements, CDS Views, APIs, and SAP–Azure integration, including solutions leveraging Azure Data Warehouse JSON payloads, Graph API identity data, and BLOB-based master data pipelines. 

A strong practitioner of AI-accelerated engineering, I use Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot CLI, Azure AI, and VS Code AI extensions to speed ABAP development, automate documentation, enhance testing, and build intelligent knowledge-based agents for any business operations. Beyond technical delivery, I bring project leadership, business analysis, and cross-functional collaboration experience—translating business requirements into scalable SAP solutions.

positions.title: SAP Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Delivered enterprise‑grade SAP HCM/HR, SAP ABAP and MDM engineering for Microsoft’s Federal SAP S/4 environment. Built high‑impact HR Master Data and MDM consolidation solutions, architected Azure‑integrated OData services, and engineered ABAP ETL pipelines for HR Core replication. 

Developed automation for PA/OM synchronization, Business Partner creation, and daily HR delta processing. 

Created an AI‑powered HR Master Data Knowledge Agent using Microsoft Copilot and Azure AI to accelerate incident resolution and improve engineering productivity. 

Played a key role in the RISE with NS2 upgrade, modernizing legacy processes and migrating workloads to Azure BLOB. 

Recognized for using AI to accelerate ABAP development, documentation, and Fiori engineering.

positions.title: SAP US Payroll Consultant
positions.description:
Supported SAP HCM and US Payroll for multistate clients, delivering configuration, ABAP debugging, and payroll issue resolution. 

Designed functional/technical specs, supported Workday & SuccessFactors integrations, and resolved complex payroll schemas, PCRs, GL postings, and BSI tax issues. 

Enhanced ADP’s US tax configuration workbook, improving accuracy and onboarding efficiency.

positions.title: SAP SuccessFactors EC Payroll Consultant
positions.description:
Provided AMS support for SuccessFactors EC Payroll for 45,000+ employees across 20+ states. 

Delivered US Payroll configuration, ABAP debugging, and EC ↔ ECP replication troubleshooting. 

Documented requirements and supported enhancements for large‑scale HR/Payroll operations.

positions.title: SAP Test Coordinator
positions.description:
Led SAP testing strategy across MM, PM, FICO, IWM, SD, and CS modules. 

Created test plans, execution reports, defect logs, and testing metrics. 

Coordinated testing with project leads and SAP IT teams to ensure quality and readiness.

positions.title: SAP HCM|Payroll Business Analyst
positions.description:
Supported SAP S/4 HANA upgrade for HCM, delivering impact analysis and integration testing. 

Developed custom ABAP reports for budgeting, forecasting, and HR analytics. 

Configured HR Benefits, US Payroll, ESS/MSS, and Savings & Retirement.

positions.title: SAP HCM|Payroll Business Analyst
positions.description:
Delivered SAP HCM configuration for Benefits, Compensation, US Payroll, Time, ESS/MSS, and LSO. 

Maintained HR interfaces with third‑party vendors and supported SAP Time Evaluation. 

Developed ABAP enhancements, Adobe forms, and configured W2 forms for ESS. Managed SAP ↔ BSI tax engine synchronization.

positions.title: SAP Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Led a 16‑person SAP COE supporting HCM, SCM, FICO, MRO, and Solumina MES for our client Sikorsky Aircraft. 

Improved SLA performance from 85% → 95% resolution within 3 business days. 

Delivered SAP upgrade regression testing for Pratt & Whitney Shanghai. 

Supported SAP MRO implementation for Belgium engine center, including LSMW migration. 

Developed ABAP enhancements, user exits, and iMRO tools for Lockheed Martin. 

Implemented ACE development estimation steps reducing cost and improving delivery.

company.name: Axon Puerto Rico (Pratt & Whitney Joint Venture)

positions.title: IS Associate Specialist
positions.description:
Managed SAP, LIMS, Trackwise, NT, and MES user accounts for 3,000+ employees. 

Increased first‑call resolution from 55% → 95%. 

Coordinated installations, relocations, and enterprise system troubleshooting.

projects.title: Doral Aquisition / Employee conversion
projects.description: Responsible for employees conversion in to SAP R3/ERP system troughs ETL process, involve in all the stages of the process ( Data extraction, conversion, Load, validation).

projects.title: SAP Performance Managment implementation
projects.description: Serve as liaison between business and Technical team in order to provide alternative and solutions to business needs. Provide technical & functional support, actively involve in all the SDLC stages( requirements gathering,implementation,testing,etc) perform system changes and process documentation.
